column1: # kind|MM-DD|year|Greek name|English name|English biography   (English versions of the short biographies in data/bios; kind is always bio)

bio|12-24|1524|Βάσκο ντα Γκάμα|Vasco da Gama|Vasco da Gama was a Portuguese explorer. In 1498 he reached India by sea, via the Cape of Good Hope, opening the sea route from Europe. He died in 1524 in Cochin.

bio|12-24|1798|Άνταμ Μιτσκιέβιτς|Adam Mickiewicz|Adam Mickiewicz was a Polish poet of Romanticism. He wrote the epic "Pan Tadeusz" and is regarded as Poland's national poet. He died in 1855 in Constantinople.

bio|12-24|1818|Τζέιμς Πρέσκοτ Τζάουλ|James Prescott Joule|James Prescott Joule was an English physicist. He studied the relationship between heat and mechanical work, and the unit of energy, the joule, bears his name. He died in 1889.
bio|12-24|1863|Ουίλλιαμ Θάκερυ|William Thackeray|William Thackeray died in 1863. He was a British writer and wrote the satirical novel "Vanity Fair".

bio|12-24|1905|Χάουαρντ Χιουζ|Howard Hughes|Howard Hughes was an American businessman, aviator and film producer. He inherited a large fortune, set flight records and founded an airline company. In his later years he lived in isolation. He died in 1976.
bio|12-24|1957|Χαμίντ Καρζάι|Hamid Karzai|Hamid Karzai is an Afghan politician. He was the first president of Afghanistan after the fall of the Taliban, from 2004 to 2014.
bio|12-24|1961|Ιλχάμ Αλίγιεφ|Ilham Aliyev|Ilham Aliyev is an Azerbaijani politician. He has been president of the country since 2003, when he succeeded his father, Heydar Aliyev.

bio|12-24|1997|Τοσίρο Μιφούνε|Toshiro Mifune|Toshiro Mifune was a Japanese actor. He appeared in films by Akira Kurosawa, such as "Rashomon" and "Seven Samurai", and became known in the West. He died in 1997.
bio|12-24|2008|Χάρολντ Πίντερ|Harold Pinter|Harold Pinter died in 2008. He was an English playwright, director and actor, and in 2005 he was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature.

bio|12-25|1876|Μοχάμεντ Αλί Τζίνα|Muhammad Ali Jinnah|Muhammad Ali Jinnah was the founder of Pakistan. He led the Muslim League and became the first governor-general of the country in 1947. He died in 1948.

bio|12-25|1899|Χάμφρεϊ Μπόγκαρτ|Humphrey Bogart|Humphrey Bogart was an American actor. He appeared in the films "Casablanca", "The Maltese Falcon" and "The African Queen", for which he won an Oscar. He died in 1957.

bio|12-25|1918|Ανουάρ Σαντάτ|Anwar Sadat|Anwar Sadat was president of Egypt from 1970 to 1981. In 1979 he signed a peace treaty with Israel and shared the Nobel Peace Prize with Begin. He was assassinated in 1981.
bio|12-25|1938|Κάρελ Τσάπεκ|Karel Čapek|Karel Čapek was a Czech writer. He wrote the play "R.U.R.", in which the word "robot" first appeared. He died in 1938.

bio|12-25|1971|Τζάστιν Τρυντώ|Justin Trudeau|Justin Trudeau is a Canadian Liberal politician. He was prime minister of Canada from 2015 to 2025 and is the son of the former prime minister Pierre Trudeau.

bio|12-25|1977|Τσάρλι Τσάπλιν|Charlie Chaplin|Charlie Chaplin was an English actor and director of silent films. He created the character of the Tramp and directed "City Lights" and "Modern Times". He died in 1977.

bio|12-25|1983|Ζουάν Μιρό|Joan Miró|Joan Miró was a Catalan painter, sculptor and ceramicist. He created a playful style with bright colours and abstract shapes, which is associated with Surrealism. He died in 1983.

bio|12-25|1989|Νικολάε Τσαουσέσκου|Nicolae Ceaușescu|Nicolae Ceaușescu was the communist leader of Romania from 1965. He was overthrown by the uprising of December 1989 and was executed on 25 December, together with his wife Elena.

bio|12-26|1194|Φρειδερίκος Β΄ Χοενστάουφεν|Frederick II Hohenstaufen|Frederick II was emperor of the Holy Roman Empire and king of Sicily. He took part in the Sixth Crusade and was a patron of science and art. He died in 1250.
bio|12-26|1530|Μπαμπούρ|Babur|Babur was the founder of the Mughal Empire of India. He won the battle of Panipat in 1526 and took Delhi. He died in 1530 in Agra.

bio|12-26|1791|Τσαρλς Μπάμπατζ|Charles Babbage|Charles Babbage was an English mathematician and engineer. He designed the Difference Engine and the Analytical Engine, forerunners of the modern computer. He died in 1871.

bio|12-26|1891|Χένρι Μίλερ|Henry Miller|Henry Miller was an American writer. He wrote "Tropic of Cancer", an autobiographical and controversial novel, which was banned in the United States for years. He died in 1980.

bio|12-26|1893|Μάο Τσετούνγκ|Mao Zedong|Mao Zedong was the founder of the People's Republic of China in 1949 and its leader until 1976. His policies, such as the "Great Leap Forward" and the Cultural Revolution, caused great losses.
bio|12-26|1971|Τζάρεντ Λέτο|Jared Leto|Jared Leto is an American actor and musician. He is the lead singer of the band 30 Seconds to Mars and won an Oscar for "Dallas Buyers Club".

bio|12-26|1972|Χάρυ Τρούμαν|Harry Truman|Harry Truman was the 33rd president of the United States, from 1945 to 1953. He ordered the atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki, and he created the Truman Doctrine and the Marshall Plan. He died in 1972.
bio|12-26|1985|Νταϊάν Φόσεϊ|Dian Fossey|Dian Fossey was an American primatologist. She studied mountain gorillas in Rwanda and wrote "Gorillas in the Mist". She was murdered in 1985.
bio|12-26|2006|Τζέραλντ Φορντ|Gerald Ford|Gerald Ford died in 2006. He was the 38th president of the United States and became president in 1974, after the resignation of Nixon.
bio|12-27|1571|Γιοχάνες Κέπλερ|Johannes Kepler|Johannes Kepler was a German astronomer and mathematician. He formulated the three laws of planetary motion. He died in 1630.
bio|12-27|1822|Λουί Παστέρ|Louis Pasteur|Louis Pasteur was a French chemist and microbiologist. He developed vaccines against rabies and anthrax and introduced pasteurisation. He died in 1895.

bio|12-27|1901|Μαρλέν Ντίτριχ|Marlene Dietrich|Marlene Dietrich was born in Germany and became an American actress and singer. She became known with the film "The Blue Angel". She opposed the Nazis and sang for the Allied troops. She died in 1992.
bio|12-27|1923|Γουστάβος Άιφελ|Gustave Eiffel|Gustave Eiffel died in 1923. He was a French engineer who designed the Eiffel Tower for the 1889 World's Fair.

bio|12-27|1934|Λαρίσα Λατίνινα|Larisa Latynina|Larisa Latynina is a Ukrainian former gymnast of the Soviet Union. She won 18 Olympic medals, a record that stood for half a century until Michael Phelps surpassed it.
bio|12-27|1948|Ζεράρ Ντεπαρντιέ|Gérard Depardieu|Gérard Depardieu is a French actor. He has appeared in more than 200 films, such as "Cyrano de Bergerac" and "Germinal".

bio|12-27|1972|Λέστερ Πήρσον|Lester Pearson|Lester Pearson was a Canadian politician and diplomat. He was prime minister of Canada from 1963 to 1968, and in 1957 he was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize for his work during the Suez Crisis. He died in 1972.
bio|12-27|1981|Έμιλι ντε Ράβιν|Emily de Ravin|Emily de Ravin is an Australian actress. She became known for the series "Lost" and "Once Upon a Time".

bio|12-27|2007|Μπεναζίρ Μπούτο|Benazir Bhutto|Benazir Bhutto was killed on 27 December 2007 in Rawalpindi, during an election rally. She was twice prime minister of Pakistan and the first woman to lead a country with a Muslim majority.
bio|12-27|2016|Κάρι Φίσερ|Carrie Fisher|Carrie Fisher died in 2016. She was an American actress and writer, known as Princess Leia in "Star Wars".

bio|12-28|1694|Μαρία Β΄|Mary II|Mary II was queen of England, Scotland and Ireland from 1689. She reigned together with her husband William III of Orange after the Glorious Revolution. She died of smallpox in 1694.

bio|12-28|1856|Γούντροου Ουίλσον|Woodrow Wilson|Woodrow Wilson was the 28th president of the United States, from 1913 to 1921. He led the country into the First World War and proposed the "Fourteen Points". In 1919 he was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize. He died in 1924.

bio|12-28|1903|Τζον φον Νόιμαν|John von Neumann|John von Neumann was born in Budapest and became an American mathematician. He contributed to game theory, quantum mechanics and computer architecture. He died in 1957.
bio|12-28|1925|Σεργκέι Γεσένιν|Sergei Yesenin|Sergei Yesenin was a Russian poet with a lyrical and rural inspiration. He took his own life in 1925, at the age of 30, in a hotel in Saint Petersburg.
bio|12-28|1937|Μωρίς Ραβέλ|Maurice Ravel|Maurice Ravel was a French composer. He wrote "Boléro", "Daphnis et Chloé" and a piano concerto. He died in 1937.
bio|12-28|1947|Βίκτωρ Εμμανουήλ Γ΄|Victor Emmanuel III|Victor Emmanuel III was king of Italy from 1900 to 1946. He handed power to Mussolini in 1922 and abdicated in 1946. He died in 1947 in Egypt.
bio|12-28|1954|Ντένζελ Ουάσινγκτον|Denzel Washington|Denzel Washington is an American actor. He won two Oscars, for "Glory" and "Training Day", and starred in "Malcolm X".
bio|12-28|1955|Λιου Σιαομπό|Liu Xiaobo|Liu Xiaobo was a Chinese writer and advocate of democracy. He was imprisoned and in 2010 he was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize. He died in 2017 in custody.

bio|12-28|1969|Λίνους Τόρβαλντς|Linus Torvalds|Linus Torvalds is a Finnish software engineer. He created the Linux kernel in 1991 and still oversees its development. He also created the Git version control system.

bio|12-29|1709|Ελισάβετ|Elizabeth Petrovna|Elizabeth Petrovna was empress of Russia from 1741 to 1762. She was the daughter of Peter the Great, and during her reign Russia took part in the Seven Years' War. She founded Moscow University. She died in 1762.

bio|12-29|1808|Άντριου Τζόνσον|Andrew Johnson|Andrew Johnson was the 17th president of the United States. He took office after the assassination of Lincoln and was the first to face impeachment proceedings, from which he escaped by a single vote. He died in 1875.

bio|12-29|1809|Ουίλιαμ Γκλάντστοουν|William Gladstone|William Gladstone was a British Liberal politician. He was four times prime minister of the United Kingdom and in 1864 he supported the union of the Ionian Islands with Greece. He died in 1898.
bio|12-29|1926|Ράινερ Μαρία Ρίλκε|Rainer Maria Rilke|Rainer Maria Rilke died in 1926 in Switzerland. He was an Austrian poet and wrote the "Duino Elegies".
bio|12-29|1938|Τζον Βόιτ|Jon Voight|Jon Voight is an American actor. He won an Oscar for "Coming Home" and appeared in "Midnight Cowboy". He is the father of Angelina Jolie.
bio|12-29|1972|Τζουντ Λο|Jude Law|Jude Law is an English actor. He became known for the films "The Talented Mr. Ripley" and "Sherlock Holmes", in which he plays Dr Watson.
bio|12-29|1986|Αντρέι Ταρκόφσκι|Andrei Tarkovsky|Andrei Tarkovsky was a Russian director. He directed the films "Andrei Rublev", "Solaris", "Stalker" and "The Sacrifice". He died in 1986.
bio|12-29|2022|Πελέ|Pelé|Pelé died on 29 December 2022, at the age of 82. He was a Brazilian footballer and won three World Cups, in 1958, 1962 and 1970.

bio|12-30|39|Τίτος|Titus|Titus was Roman emperor from 79 to 81. He was the son of Vespasian and, as a general, captured Jerusalem in 70. During his reign the eruption of Vesuvius took place and the Colosseum was completed.

bio|12-30|1865|Ράντγιαρντ Κίπλινγκ|Rudyard Kipling|Rudyard Kipling was a British writer. He was born in India and wrote "The Jungle Book" and the poem "If". In 1907 he became the youngest person to be awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature. He died in 1936.

bio|12-30|1884|Τότζο Χιντέκι|Hideki Tojo|Hideki Tojo was a Japanese military officer and prime minister of Japan from 1941 to 1944. He led the country into the Pacific War. He was convicted as a war criminal and hanged in 1948.

bio|12-30|1916|Γκριγκόρι Ρασπούτιν|Grigori Rasputin|Grigori Rasputin was a Russian mystic. He had great influence at the court of Tsar Nicholas II, and his murder in December 1916 was carried out by nobles. His death took place on 17 December of the old calendar, that is on 30 December of the new.

bio|12-30|1944|Ρομαίν Ρολάν|Romain Rolland|Romain Rolland was a French writer and pacifist. He wrote the novel "Jean-Christophe" and in 1915 he was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature. He died in 1944.
bio|12-30|1975|Τάιγκερ Γουντς|Tiger Woods|Tiger Woods is an American golfer. He won 15 major tournaments and for years was at the top of the world ranking.

bio|12-30|1984|ΛεΜπρόν Τζέιμς|LeBron James|LeBron James is an American basketball player. He played for the Cleveland Cavaliers, the Miami Heat and the Los Angeles Lakers, and won four NBA championships. He is the all-time top scorer in NBA history.

bio|12-30|2006|Σαντάμ Χουσεΐν|Saddam Hussein|Saddam Hussein was president of Iraq from 1979 to 2003, when he was overthrown by the international invasion. He ruled as a dictator and fought Iran and Kuwait. He was tried and hanged in 2006.

bio|12-30|2012|Ρίτα Λέβι Μονταλτσίνι|Rita Levi-Montalcini|Rita Levi-Montalcini was an Italian neurologist. She discovered nerve growth factor, and in 1986 she was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine. She died in 2012, at the age of 103.
bio|12-31|192|Κόμμοδος|Commodus|Commodus was Roman emperor from 180 to 192. He was the son of Marcus Aurelius and was assassinated on 31 December 192 by conspirators. His death led to civil conflict.

bio|12-31|1514|Ανδρέας Βεσάλιος|Andreas Vesalius|Andreas Vesalius was a Flemish anatomist. His work "De humani corporis fabrica" in 1543 corrected many ancient ideas and is regarded as the foundation of modern anatomy. He died in 1564.
bio|12-31|1691|Ρόμπερτ Μπόιλ|Robert Boyle|Robert Boyle was an Irish chemist and physicist. He formulated Boyle's law for gases and is regarded as one of the first modern chemists. He died in 1691.
bio|12-31|1869|Ανρί Ματίς|Henri Matisse|Henri Matisse was a French painter and sculptor and the leading figure of Fauvism. He became known for his intense colours and simple shapes. He died in 1954.

bio|12-31|1877|Γκυστάβ Κουρμπέ|Gustave Courbet|Gustave Courbet was a French painter and a leading figure of Realism. He painted "The Origin of the World" and "The Stone Breakers". He died in 1877 in Switzerland.
bio|12-31|1935|Σαλμάν|Salman|Salman bin Abdulaziz has been king of Saudi Arabia since 2015. Before that he was governor of Riyadh for many years and minister of defence.

bio|12-31|1936|Μιγκέλ ντε Ουναμούνο|Miguel de Unamuno|Miguel de Unamuno was a Spanish writer and philosopher. He wrote "The Tragic Sense of Life" and was rector of the University of Salamanca. He died in 1936, at the beginning of the Spanish Civil War.
bio|12-31|1937|Άντονι Χόπκινς|Anthony Hopkins|Anthony Hopkins is a Welsh actor. He won two Oscars, for his role as Hannibal Lecter in "The Silence of the Lambs" and for "The Father".

bio|12-31|1941|Άλεξ Φέργκιουσον|Alex Ferguson|Alex Ferguson is a former Scottish footballer and coach. He was manager of Manchester United from 1986 to 2013 and won 13 English league titles and two Champions Leagues.
